intro.heading: KARAN
intro.description: I am a 2nd-year B.Tech CSE student (MAKAUT-affiliated, West Bengal) and a T-shaped developer who works across the full stack. From frontend to AI integrations to DevOps — I build and ship real products. Ayushman, the founder of Elixpo, guided me into open source and shaped my understanding of collaborative development.

fancySection.subtitle: Experience & Interests
fancySection.content: I am currently a Frontend AI Engineering Intern at FlyRank AI and a core contributor at Elixpo. Ayushman introduced me to open source when I was confused about what direction to take — and that changed everything. Since then, I've contributed to Pollinations, built Kareixo (an AI code reviewer), shipped Nirmaan MUN, and worked across multiple Elixpo products.
fancySection.contactNote: Interested in collaboration, internships, or freelance work? Feel free to reach out.
fancySection.shoutoutText: for shaping my technical journey and growth.
